role: ADR 006: the project compiles in Swift 6 language mode with complete strict concurrency in every configuration; check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh guards the setting and the unchecked-Sendable allowlist counts escapes.

units.key: § ADR 006 — Swift 6 language mode is the concurrency gate
units.does: Claims Swift 6 mode + SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete in all eight configurations, check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh fails CI if any leaves it, the escape count is the figure in .ci/unchecked_sendable_budget.txt, and lists the remaining escapes (StrapAPI, WhisperKit feeder, AmbientLocationService, ActiveRouteSession, backups, SessionArchive, BaselineTracker, ConversationStore, SystemDiagnosticsManager, KeyboardPerfSignpost); background readers must use settingsSnapshot; there is no diagnostic budget, the compiler is the gate. Verified: project.pbxproj has 8 'SWIFT_VERSION = 6.0' and 8 'SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete' lines; budget 14.
